full_prompt_en: The image is a square extreme close-up color photograph of part of a man's face. One blue-green eye dominates the upper middle, its amber ring and dark pupil sharply visible. The eye sits beneath a heavy brow and the edge of a dark hood or cap. Only part of the nose appears at the far left, and the lower frame crops across cheek and facial hair. The cheek carries dense freckles, spots, pores, and weathered skin texture. A small bright sheen lies just below the eye, while the side of the face falls into deep brown-black shade. Short dark beard hairs and stubble appear along the lower edge. The lens is close enough to show individual lashes and tiny changes in skin color. Warm rust and copper tones fill the lit skin, contrasting with the cool blue-green iris and near-black cloth. The background is essentially absent; the hood and dark shadow occupy the right edge. Light comes from the left and slightly above, grazing the brow, under-eye area, and textured cheek. It creates a strong but detailed contrast, preserving surface information in the highlights rather than washing them to white. The crop is deliberately incomplete, offering a fragment rather than a conventional full face. This makes the eye and weathered skin feel almost like a landscape of planes and marks. The image is direct and intense, but its strength is observational: pores, freckles, slight moisture, and coarse stubble remain as important as the gaze. The photographic finish is sharp at the eye and subtly softer at the outer edges, giving the close subject depth without a distracting setting.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形极近距离彩色照片，只拍到男子脸的一部分。一只蓝绿色眼占据上方中央，琥珀色内环和深瞳清晰可见。眼在浓眉及深色兜帽或帽边下。鼻仅在最左露出局部，下边裁过脸颊和胡须。脸颊有密集雀斑、斑点、毛孔和饱经风霜的皮肤肌理。眼下有一小片亮泽，脸侧则落入深褐黑影。短深胡毛与胡茬在下缘显出。镜头近到可看见独立睫毛与皮肤颜色微小变化。受光皮肤充满暖锈与铜色，对照冷蓝绿虹膜和近黑布。背景基本缺席；兜帽和深影占据右边。光从左上方来，擦过眉、眼下与有肌理的脸颊。它产生强烈却细致的反差，高光中仍留表面信息，而非冲成白。裁切有意不完整，呈现碎片而非常规整脸。这使眼与旧皮肤几乎像由平面和痕迹组成的地形。图像直接而强烈，但力量来自观察：毛孔、雀斑、少许湿润和粗胡茬与目光同样重要。摄影成品在眼处锐利，外边缘微柔，使贴近主体仍有纵深且无需分散注意的场景。
style_prompt_en: Extreme close photographic treatment enlarges one sharply focused detail until surrounding surface becomes a tactile field. Pores, freckles, fine hairs, tiny highlights, and local color shifts remain plainly visible. Warm copper and rust skinlike tones may oppose a small cool blue-green focal accent, with dark fabric or shadow enclosing the crop. Light grazes from one side, producing strong contrast without erasing the microtexture of the highlights. The frame cuts forms abruptly, withholding the full object and making its fragment feel nearly abstract. Focus falls slightly at the outer edge. The result is intense, observational, and materially specific.
style_prompt_zh: 极近摄影把一个锐利对焦的细节放大到周围表面成为可触的区域。毛孔、雀斑、细毛、小亮点与局部色变都明显可见。暖铜和锈色的皮肤般调子可对照一处冷蓝绿焦点，深布或阴影封住裁切。光从一侧擦过，产生强反差，却不抹去亮处微肌理。画边突然截断形体，不给出物件全貌，使碎片近乎抽象。焦点在外缘略衰减。结果强烈、观察入微且材料具体。
theme_en: An extreme crop of a weathered face with one blue-green eye
theme_zh: 极近裁切一张饱经风霜的脸和一只蓝绿色眼
name: Extreme close-up portrait
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
